stories.title: North Wales Police is warning about suspicious calls showing their own 0300 330 0101 number
stories.summary: North Wales Police is warning people about suspicious calls from a number showing as its own non-emergency line, 0300 330 0101. The force said it received multiple reports last night from people who had received numerous missed calls from the number. stories.title: North Wales police commissioner seeks views on council tax rise
stories.summary: Andy Dunbobbin has launched a consultation on four options, ranging from 34p to 45p a week per Band D household, to raise North Wales Police's funding.

stories.title: Police warn people across North Wales over missed delivery scam texts

stories.title: Sixteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Mold worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Mold face 10 sets of roadworks today, with Llys Nercwys closed until Wednesday 2 December.
